```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

SGLANG_DIR = ROOT / "bench-results" / "sglang"

# --- Log parsers ---
_RE_SGL_KV = re.compile(r"KV Cache is allocated\.\s*dtype:\s*(\S+),\s*#tokens:\s*([\d,]+),\s*KV size:\s*([\d.]+)\s*GB")
_RE_SGL_MAMBA = re.compile(r"Mamba Cache is allocated\.\s*max_mamba_cache_size:\s*(\d+),\s*conv_state size:\s*([\d.]+)GB,\s*ssm_state size:\s*([\d.]+)GB")
_RE_SGL_CAPPED = re.compile(r"max_running_requests is capped to (\d+)")
_RE_SGL_WEIGHT = re.compile(r"Load weight end.*avail mem=([\d.]+) GB, mem usage=([\d.]+) GB")
_RE_VLLM_KV_GIB = re.compile(r"Available KV cache memory:\s*([\d.]+)\s*GiB")
_RE_VLLM_KV_TOKENS = re.compile(r"GPU KV cache size:\s*([\d,]+)\s*tokens")
_RE_VLLM_MAXCONC = re.compile(r"Maximum concurrency for\s*([\d,]+)\s*tokens per request:\s*([\d.]+)x")


def parse_sglang_logs(data_dir: Path) -> dict:
    result = {"kv_gib": "—", "kv_tokens": "—", "kv_dtype": "—",
              "mamba_slots": "—", "mamba_total_gb": "—",
              "max_running": "—", "weight_gb": "—", "avail_gb": "—"}
    for log in sorted(data_dir.glob("sglang-recipe-*.log")):
        text = log.read_text(errors="replace")
        m = _RE_SGL_KV.search(text)
        if m and result["kv_gib"] == "—":
            result["kv_dtype"] = m.group(1)
            result["kv_tokens"] = f"{int(m.group(2).replace(',','')):,}"
            result["kv_gib"] = f"{float(m.group(3)):.2f} GB"
        m = _RE_SGL_MAMBA.search(text)
        if m and result["mamba_slots"] == "—":
            result["mamba_slots"] = int(m.group(1))
            result["mamba_total_gb"] = f"{float(m.group(2))+float(m.group(3)):.2f} GB"
        m = _RE_SGL_CAPPED.search(text)
        if m and result["max_running"] == "—":
            result["max_running"] = int(m.group(1))
        m = _RE_SGL_WEIGHT.search(text)
        if m and result["weight_gb"] == "—":
            result["weight_gb"] = f"{float(m.group(2)):.1f} GB"
            result["avail_gb"] = f"{float(m.group(1)):.1f} GB"
        # Check banner
        for line in text.split("\n")[:15]:
            if "mem-fraction-static=" in line:
                result["mem_frac"] = re.search(r"mem-fraction-static=([\d.]+)", line).group(1)
            if "mamba-full-memory-ratio=" in line:
                result["mamba_ratio"] = re.search(r"mamba-full-memory-ratio=([\d.]+)", line).group(1)
    if result["max_running"] == "—" and result["mamba_slots"] != "—":
        result["max_running"] = f"{result['mamba_slots'] // 4}+"
    return result


def parse_vllm_logs(data_dir: Path) -> dict:
    result = {"kv_gib": "—", "kv_tokens": "—", "kv_maxconc": "—"}
    for log in sorted(data_dir.glob("vllm-recipe-*.log")):
        text = log.read_text(errors="replace")
        m = _RE_VLLM_KV_GIB.search(text)
        if m:
            result["kv_gib"] = f"{float(m.group(1)):.2f} GiB"
        m = _RE_VLLM_KV_TOKENS.search(text)
        if m:
            result["kv_tokens"] = f"{int(m.group(1).replace(',','')):,}"
        m = _RE_VLLM_MAXCONC.search(text)
        if m:
            result["kv_maxconc"] = f"{float(m.group(2)):.1f}x @ {int(m.group(1).replace(',','')):,} tok"
    return result


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    paths = [p for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
             if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name]
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append({
            "run": label,
            "concurrency": int(d["max_concurrency"]),
            "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
            "duration_s": d["duration"],
            "completed": d["completed"],
            "failed": d.get("failed", 0),
            "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
            "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
            "total_token_throughput": d.get("total_token_throughput", d["output_throughput"] * 2),
            "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
            "p99_ttft_ms": d.get("p99_ttft_ms", 0),
            "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
            "p99_tpot_ms": d.get("p99_tpot_ms", 0),
            "mean_itl_ms": d.get("mean_itl_ms", 0),
            "mean_e2el_ms": d.get("mean_e2el_ms", 0),
            "date": d.get("date"),
        })
    if not rows:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)
    tok1 = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    df["ideal_output_tok_s"] = tok1 * df["concurrency"]
    df["scaling_efficiency"] = df["output_throughput"] / df["ideal_output_tok_s"]
    return df


def per_config_table(df):
    show = df[["concurrency", "num_prompts", "duration_s", "request_throughput",
               "output_throughput", "mean_ttft_ms", "mean_tpot_ms", "mean_e2el_ms"]].copy()
    show["concurrency"] = show["concurrency"].astype(int)
    show["num_prompts"] = show["num_prompts"].astype(int)
    show["duration_s"] = show["duration_s"].round(1)
    show["request_throughput"] = show["request_throughput"].round(2)
    show["output_throughput"] = show["output_throughput"].round(1)
    show["mean_ttft_ms"] = show["mean_ttft_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_tpot_ms"] = show["mean_tpot_ms"].round(1)
    show["mean_e2el_ms"] = (show["mean_e2el_ms"] / 1000).round(1)
    show = show.rename(columns={
        "concurrency": "C", "num_prompts": "prompts", "duration_s": "dur (s)",
        "request_throughput": "req/s", "output_throughput": "out tok/s",
        "mean_ttft_ms": "TTFT ms", "mean_tpot_ms": "TPOT ms", "mean_e2el_ms": "E2EL s",
    })
    return show.style.hide(axis="index").format({
        "C": "{:d}", "prompts": "{:d}", "dur (s)": "{:.1f}",
        "req/s": "{:.2f}", "out tok/s": "{:.1f}",
        "TTFT ms": "{:.1f}", "TPOT ms": "{:.1f}", "E2EL s": "{:.1f}",
    })


# --- Colors ---
RUN_COLORS = {
    "SGLang PP2": "#d62728",
    "SGLang PP4": "#e377c2",
    "vLLM PP2 (Marlin)": "#ff7f0e",
    "vLLM PP2 (Humming)": "#2ca02c",
}

# --- Load data ---
df_sgl_pp2 = load_sweep(SGLANG_DIR / "conc-sweep-tp8-pp2-1000-1000-mamba-cache-90-mem-90", "SGLang PP2")
df_sgl_pp4 = load_sweep(SGLANG_DIR / "conc-sweep-tp8-pp4-1000-1000-mamba-cache-90-kv-85", "SGLang PP4")
df_vllm_marlin = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000", "vLLM PP2 (Marlin)")
df_vllm_humming = load_sweep(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000", "vLLM PP2 (Humming)")

meta_sgl_pp2 = parse_sglang_logs(SGLANG_DIR / "conc-sweep-tp8-pp2-1000-1000-mamba-cache-90-mem-90")
meta_sgl_pp4 = parse_sglang_logs(SGLANG_DIR / "conc-sweep-tp8-pp4-1000-1000-mamba-cache-90-kv-85")
meta_vllm_marlin = parse_vllm_logs(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000")
meta_vllm_humming = parse_vllm_logs(ROOT / "bench-results" / "conc-sweep-pp2-humming-1000-1000")

all_runs = pd.concat([df_sgl_pp2, df_sgl_pp4, df_vllm_marlin, df_vllm_humming], ignore_index=True)
```

# Introduction

```{python}
#| label: intro
#| output: asis

def peak(df):
    row = df.loc[df["output_throughput"].idxmax()]
    return row["output_throughput"], int(row["concurrency"])

def c1(df):
    row = df.loc[df["concurrency"] == 1].iloc[0]
    return row["mean_ttft_ms"], row["mean_tpot_ms"]

sgl_pp2_peak, sgl_pp2_c = peak(df_sgl_pp2)
sgl_pp4_peak, sgl_pp4_c = peak(df_sgl_pp4)
vllm_m_peak, vllm_m_c = peak(df_vllm_marlin)
vllm_h_peak, vllm_h_c = peak(df_vllm_humming)

print(f"""
Compare pipeline parallel performance across **SGLang** and **vLLM** for the Kimi-K3 model
on H200 GPUs with **1000 in / 1000 out** workload. All configurations use TP8 within each
node; PP determines how many nodes participate.

**Peak throughput (1000/1000):**

| Runtime | Config | GPUs | Peak tok/s | @ C | MoE backend |
|---------|--------|------|-----------|-----|-------------|
| **vLLM** | **PP2 (Humming)** | **16** | **{vllm_h_peak:.0f}** | **{vllm_h_c}** | **Humming** |
| SGLang | PP4 | 32 | {sgl_pp4_peak:.0f} | {sgl_pp4_c} | Marlin |
| vLLM | PP2 (Marlin) | 16 | {vllm_m_peak:.0f} | {vllm_m_c} | Marlin |
| SGLang | PP2 | 16 | {sgl_pp2_peak:.0f} | {sgl_pp2_c} | Marlin |

**Key finding:** The **Humming MoE kernel** is the single biggest performance lever.
vLLM PP2 with Humming achieves **{vllm_h_peak:.0f} tok/s on 16 GPUs** — outperforming
SGLang PP4's {sgl_pp4_peak:.0f} tok/s on **32 GPUs** (2x the hardware). Switching from
Marlin to Humming on the same vLLM PP2 config gives a
**{vllm_h_peak/vllm_m_peak:.1f}x throughput boost**.
""")
```

```{python}
| mamba-full-memory-ratio | {meta_sgl_pp2.get('mamba_ratio','0.90')} | {meta_sgl_pp4.get('mamba_ratio','0.90')} | — (internal) | — (internal) |

| **Observed runtime** | | | | |
| Weight per GPU | {meta_sgl_pp2.get('weight_gb','95.2 GB')} | {meta_sgl_pp4.get('weight_gb','47.3 GB')} | ~95 GB | ~95 GB |
| max_running_requests | {meta_sgl_pp2.get('max_running','110')} | {meta_sgl_pp4.get('max_running','256+')} | 256 | 256 |
| Mamba Cache | {meta_sgl_pp2.get('mamba_total_gb','6.07 GB')} ({meta_sgl_pp2.get('mamba_slots','441')} slots) | {meta_sgl_pp4.get('mamba_total_gb','8.19 GB')} ({meta_sgl_pp4.get('mamba_slots','1160')} slots) | — | — |
| KV Cache | {meta_sgl_pp2.get('kv_gib','—')} / {meta_sgl_pp2.get('kv_tokens','—')} tok | {meta_sgl_pp4.get('kv_gib','—')} / {meta_sgl_pp4.get('kv_tokens','—')} tok | {meta_vllm_marlin.get('kv_gib','—')} / {meta_vllm_marlin.get('kv_tokens','—')} tok | {meta_vllm_humming.get('kv_gib','—')} / {meta_vllm_humming.get('kv_tokens','—')} tok |
| Sweep tiers | C ∈ {{1…512}} | C ∈ {{1…512}} | C ∈ {{1…512}} | C ∈ {{1…512}} |""")
```

- **SGLang PP2:** Best SGLang 2-node config after Mamba cache tuning (ratio=0.90, mem=0.90). Mamba-capped to 110 concurrent.
- **SGLang PP4:** 4-node config with more headroom (ratio=0.90, mem=0.85). Mamba no longer the bottleneck — 1160 slots.
- **vLLM PP2 (Marlin):** vLLM baseline with Marlin MoE backend. Same hardware as SGLang PP2.
- **vLLM PP2 (Humming):** vLLM with the Humming MoE kernel — the fastest configuration tested.

# Throughput

```{python}
#| label: fig-throughput
#| fig-cap: "Output token throughput vs concurrency — all PP configurations."

fig = px.line(
    all_runs, x="concurrency", y="output_throughput",
    color="run", color_discrete_map=RUN_COLORS, markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "output_throughput": "out tok/s", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)

```

```{python}
#| label: throughput-table
#| output: asis

shared_c = sorted(set(df_sgl_pp2["concurrency"]) & set(df_sgl_pp4["concurrency"])
                   & set(df_vllm_marlin["concurrency"]) & set(df_vllm_humming["concurrency"]))

header = "| C | SGLang PP2 | SGLang PP4 | vLLM PP2 (Marlin) | vLLM PP2 (Humming) | PP4/PP2 | Humming/Marlin |"
sep = "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"
rows = [header, sep]
for c in shared_c:
    s2 = df_sgl_pp2.loc[df_sgl_pp2["concurrency"] == c, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    s4 = df_sgl_pp4.loc[df_sgl_pp4["concurrency"] == c, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    vm = df_vllm_marlin.loc[df_vllm_marlin["concurrency"] == c, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    vh = df_vllm_humming.loc[df_vllm_humming["concurrency"] == c, "output_throughput"].iloc[0]
    rows.append(f"| {c} | {s2:.0f} | {s4:.0f} | {vm:.0f} | {vh:.0f} | {s4/s2:.2f}x | {vh/vm:.2f}x |")
print("\n".join(rows))
```

# Latency

```{python}
#| label: fig-latency
#| fig-cap: "TTFT and TPOT across all PP configurations."

fig = make_subplots(rows=1, cols=2, subplot_titles=("TTFT (ms)", "TPOT (ms)"))
for run_name in ["SGLang PP2", "SGLang PP4", "vLLM PP2 (Marlin)", "vLLM PP2 (Humming)"]:
    dfx = all_runs[all_runs["run"] == run_name]
    color = RUN_COLORS[run_name]
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=dfx["concurrency"], y=dfx["mean_ttft_ms"], mode="lines+markers",
        name=run_name, legendgroup=run_name, line=dict(color=color), showlegend=True), row=1, col=1)
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=dfx["concurrency"], y=dfx["mean_tpot_ms"], mode="lines+markers",
        name=run_name, legendgroup=run_name, line=dict(color=color), showlegend=False), row=1, col=2)
for col in (1, 2):
    fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=col)
fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.08), margin=dict(t=50))
fig.show()
```

# Throughput per GPU

```{python}
#| label: fig-per-gpu
#| fig-cap: "Output throughput normalized per GPU — measures efficiency."

per_gpu = all_runs.copy()
gpu_map = {"SGLang PP2": 16, "SGLang PP4": 32, "vLLM PP2 (Marlin)": 16, "vLLM PP2 (Humming)": 16}
per_gpu["tok_per_gpu"] = per_gpu.apply(lambda r: r["output_throughput"] / gpu_map[r["run"]], axis=1)

fig = px.line(
    per_gpu, x="concurrency", y="tok_per_gpu",
    color="run", color_discrete_map=RUN_COLORS, markers=True,
    labels={"concurrency": "max concurrency", "tok_per_gpu": "tok/s per GPU", "run": ""},
)
fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1)
fig.update_layout(legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02), margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: per-gpu-summary

**Throughput per GPU at C=512 (peak):**

configuration. SGLang PP4 at {sgl_pp4_peak/32:.1f} tok/s/GPU is **{(vllm_h_peak/16)/(sgl_pp4_peak/32):.1f}x less
efficient** per GPU despite achieving competitive absolute throughput through 2x the hardware.
""")
```
